nodes.title: Find and Replace Pixaroma (1. the words on the label)
Prompt Pixaroma (2. the picture around the words)

promptState.text: A hero product photograph of a round glass jar of honey on a pale oak kitchen table by a window. The jar is about 10 cm tall, filled to the shoulder with golden amber honey that glows where the light passes through it, and closed with a matte black metal lid. A cream paper label wraps the front of the jar and carries the word "[NAME]" in bold dark brown serif capitals across its middle, with the words "[SECOND LINE]" in small black sans-serif capitals on one line below it. A wooden honey dipper rests on a small plain white saucer at the right, a thin drip of honey on its tip, and three dried lavender stems lie on the table at the left. Clear morning daylight from a window at camera-left lights the jar from the side, drawing a long bright highlight down the glass and a soft shadow to the right. Behind it, a plain sage green painted wall stays slightly soft. Shot at eye level, front-on, with a 90mm lens at f/8, the label sharp and centred in the frame. True-to-life colour, the crisp texture of the paper label and the glass, a little fine grain.

{"version":1,"content":"

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 FLUX 3 needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer, the first version with FLUX 3. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no flux3 type and some nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 FLUX 3 needs a free approval first (one time only)

Black Forest Labs keeps the FLUX 3 files behind a short approval on Hugging Face. Until you do it, every FLUX 3 download link below answers "Access to model ... is restricted ... Please log in".

  1. Log in to Hugging Face (a free account).
  2. Open the FLUX 3 model page with the button below and click Agree and access repository. Access is given at once.
  3. Now the download links below work, in the same browser.

FLUX 3 Klein on Hugging Face 

 Downloading with ComfyUI-Manager or a script needs a Hugging Face token as well (hf auth login). In the browser, being logged in is enough.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors5.83 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist.

Take the file WITHOUT base in its name: that is the distilled (fast) model these workflows use. The files with base in the name are the base model, made for training LoRAs: it needs CFG 3.5 and 25 to 50 steps, and at the settings here (15 or 16 steps, CFG 1) its pictures come out smeared and broken.

Already have flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors? That is the same file under its first name (ComfyUI's own template used it at launch). Pick it in this node instead of downloading it again.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors4.86 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae.safetensors336 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

The same file as Flux 2 Klein: if you have it, skip this one.

 Google Gemini Free Prompting Gem

Type your idea into the Gem with the words you want in the picture in double quotes, and it writes the long prompt with the lettering described. Paste it into 2. the picture around the words, words included: the word boxes then have nothing to fill and pass it on as it is.

Tip: start your message with write the prompt: so Gemini writes a prompt and does not try to make the picture itself. It is free with a Google account.

FLUX 3 Prompt Writer 

 License

FLUX 3 Image Klein is released under the FLUX Kommunity License. You may use the pictures commercially only while your yearly revenue (all the money coming in, before costs), together with any company you belong to, is under US$5 million. Read it before you use the model for paid work.

FLUX 3 Klein model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

FLUX 3 Klein writes words into a picture: labels, signs, book covers, cakes, t-shirts. Here the words sit in their own boxes, so you can make a new label by changing only the words, while the rest of the prompt stays as it is.

 Steps

  1. In Find and Replace Pixaroma, type your words in the right-hand boxes: the big name in the first row, the small line in the second.
  2. Change the picture in Prompt Pixaroma if you like. Keep [NAME] and [SECOND LINE] where the words go.
  3. Pick a size on Sizes Pixaroma.
  4. Leave the seed on F to repeat a picture, or switch it to R for a new one every Run.
  5. Press Run, then check every word.

 Writing words into a picture

  1. Put each word holder in double quotes, once: the word "[NAME]".
  2. Say how the letters look and their colour: bold dark brown serif capitals, rounded cream-white capitals with a thin outline.
  3. Say where they sit: across the middle of the label, along the top of the cover.
  4. Call everything else that could carry writing plain (a plain white saucer, a plain wall). Bottles, boxes, books and signs get made-up letters when the prompt leaves them open.

 CAPITAL letters are the most reliable. A handwritten script font can change the letters, for example a capital turning small.

 One line only? Delete the sentence with [SECOND LINE] from the prompt. Switching its row off in Find and Replace is not enough: the holder then stays in the prompt and the label prints [SECOND LINE] as words. More lines? Add a holder like [TAGLINE] to the prompt and a row for it in Find and Replace.

 What it is not good at (yet)

  • Check every word: in our tests a name and a short second line came out right 12 times out of 12, but longer text was not tested here. A wrong letter? Try another seed.
  • The font you name is a style, not an exact font: one of our 4 seeds drew sans-serif letters where we asked for serif.
  • Small words far away get soft. Keep the text big in the frame, or pick Full HD or 2K.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (FLUX 3 Klein, distilled) - The image model, FLUX 3 Image Klein from Black Forest Labs, the distilled version (no base in the file name): 15 steps, CFG 1. It makes a picture from words AND changes a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 4B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something FLUX 3 understands. The type must be flux3.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE) - Turns the finished render into a picture. FLUX 3 uses the same VAE as Flux 2.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Find and Replace Pixaroma (1. the words on the label) - Your words go here. Each row swaps a word holder in the prompt for the words in its right-hand box: [NAME] becomes the big name, [SECOND LINE] the small line under it. Change only these to make a new label; the preview on the node shows the finished prompt.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (2. the picture around the words) - The picture: a product photo of a honey jar. [NAME] and [SECOND LINE] mark where the words go, each in double quotes with its lettering, colour and place (see How to Use). Change the scene here; change the words in Find and Replace Pixaroma.
  • Sizes Pixaroma (3. picture size) - The picture size. Click a size; the Portrait / Landscape switch turns it on its side. The demo is 1024 x 1280. Full HD and 2K give more detail and take longer (see Run Times).
  • Seed Pixaroma (4. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same picture every Run, R (random) a new one each Run. The demo uses seed 3.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. FLUX 3 distilled runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas the picture is painted on, at the size it receives.
  • KSampler (15 steps) - The render: 15 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple. Black Forest Labs' own workflow uses 16 steps. In our tests 8 steps gave nearly the same picture in about half the time; more than 16 steps made skin smoother and more waxy.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the picture) - Saves each picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Flux 3 Klein Text and shows it on the node.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

SizeTime
1024 x 1024about 2 s
1024 x 1280 (the demo)about 3 s
Full HD, 1088 x 1920about 5 s
2K, 1440 x 2560about 9 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (FLUX 3 and its text encoder, about 11 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.
